ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( AND( TEXT(Stage__c) != 'Visa In Progress', TEXT(Stage__c) != 'Pending Arrival', TEXT(Stage__c) != 'Arrived', TEXT(Stage__c) != 'Commission Received', TEXT(Stage__c) != 'Commission Paid', TEXT(Stage__c) != 'Reject' ), TEXT( Visa_Required__c )='Yes' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: IF Visa Required is 'Yes' then Stage should be either ''Pending Arrival', 'Arrived', 'Commission Received' , 'Commission Paid' ,'Visa In Progress' or Reject.
